messages:
Emily Chen: Hi all, hitting 403 when I try to access Project Settings -> Billing for project rd-epoch. Worked yesterday. Browser shows "403 Permission denied" and CLI calls to the console API return the same. Not an org admin, I'm listed as project.admin.

Chris Li: hey emily — can you paste the curl you used and the user membership record from the API? 

Emily Chen: curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/rd-epoch/billing
# => {"error":{"status":403,"message":"permission denied"}}
```
Membership entry:
```
{"id":"u-1212","email":"emily@acme.com","roles":[{"scope":"project","role":"project.admin","project_id":"rd-epoch"}],"inherited_from":null}
```

Mira Kapoor: hmm SCIM sync ran about an hour ago for acme-enterprise. infra-bot or sync-bot, any recent role mapping changes?

sync-bot: SCIM sync completed for acme-enterprise at 2026-11-05T18:02:11Z; mappings applied: sso->project.viewer default; admin mapping requires group tag "is_admin"

Raj Singh: we rolled a tighter mapping yesterday to avoid accidental admin grants. If the SAML group lost the admin tag during SCIM, folks would drop to project.viewer. Billing requires project.billing or project.admin. 

Emily Chen: I checked my SAML group attributes — the group used to have is_admin=true but the SCIM export shows it missing for acme-admins. Not sure why.

Chris Li: can someone with org-admin rights check the group->role mapping for u-1212 via the org members API? Also try listing project roles for rd-epoch.

Mira Kapoor: org-admin @Raj can you run this?

Raj Singh: running
```
GET /api/v1/orgs/acme/members/u-1212
# response shows roles: project.viewer (inherited from group gd-55; admin flag false)
```

Raj Singh: confirmed — group mapping lost admin tag during sync. Looks like SCIM payload from IdP had group metadata cleared. We're investigating IdP logs.

Chris Li: short-term workaround: an org-admin can add a one-off project.billing role to u-1212 for rd-epoch or re-add the is_admin tag on the group and re-sync. Which is faster?

Mira Kapoor: org-admin add is faster if someone can do it. Otherwise infra can re-sync after we reapply the tag.

Emily Chen: we don't have an org-admin available in my team right now. Any way I can use a service token? I do have a service account token for deployment but it doesn't have elevated perms.

Raj Singh: service tokens are scoped; unless it was provisioned with owner or billing scope it won't help. I'm going to create an incident ticket and add this as high priority. infra-bot: create incident INC-20261105-2041 for acme-enterprise SSO mapping regression.

infra-bot: Incident INC-20261105-2041 created; assigned to infra-ops; priority P1; tags: scim, sso, billing-access

Mira Kapoor: while infra works it, I'll add a temporary mapping rule: if group.name matches "acme-admins" then grant project.admin and project.billing on a hotfix branch. Applying now.

sync-bot: applying temporary mapping override for acme-admins -> project.admin,project.billing

Chris Li: once mapping is applied, Emily try logging out and back in, and re-run the curl. If you still see 403, clear local cookies.

Emily Chen: re-logged in and billing page loads. curl to billing returns 200 and billing JSON. Woohoo.

Raj Singh: root cause: IdP SCIM export dropped group metadata (is_admin) leading to default mapping to project.viewer after our mapping change. Remediation: 1) infra to add monitoring to detect sudden drops in admin-tagged groups; 2) support to notify potentially affected tenants; 3) mapping docs updated to call out the dependency on group metadata.

Mira Kapoor: action items: Mira to push mapping override to prod for acme-enterprise until IdP fix; Raj to liaise with IdP; Chris to draft customer-facing note; Emily please confirm if anything else still broken.

Emily Chen: all good for now, thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick fix. :heart:

Chris Li: I'll close the support thread after we confirm postmortem notes. Add this to #postmortems for a short writeup.

sync-bot: SCIM re-sync completed at 2026-11-05T18:18:35Z after manual tags re-added

Raj Singh: marking incident resolved for now; follow-up: automate detection + fallback grant for project.billing when admin tag missing for known admin groups.

Emily Chen: thanks team! :thumbsup:
